{
  "project_id": "P-SRB-CompetitivenessJobs",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Weak inter‑ministerial coordination may delay policy reforms and reduce effectiveness of the PPMC system.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Formalize the PPMC Working Group mandate, set clear roles, enforce semi‑annual reporting and senior‑level oversight.",
      "evidence": "Section 24‑27: weak strategic planning and policy coordination; PPMC framework to be piloted."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Public Policy Secretariat lacks sufficient fiduciary, procurement and reporting capacity to manage the loan.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire dedicated procurement and financial management specialists; provide intensive training and on‑the‑job coaching.",
      "evidence": "Section 60‑66: PPS capacity will have to be built; procurement expert to be hired."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Procurement delays due to PPS and implementing agencies’ inexperience with World Bank procedures.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Engage a qualified procurement expert, conduct intensive procurement training, and use Bank‑provided templates.",
      "evidence": "Section 86‑88: PPS has no experience; mitigation includes hiring procurement expert and training."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Failure to achieve Disbursement‑Linked Indicators (DLIs) could trigger withholding of loan disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust monitoring, early verification of DLI evidence, and develop contingency action plans for each DLI.",
      "evidence": "Section 58‑60: DLIs condition disbursements; partial payments and reassessment procedures described."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Overlapping mandates and lack of transparency among MoE agencies may lead to inefficient use of public funds.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Restructure agencies with clear legal bases, define performance targets, and institute regular public reporting.",
      "evidence": "Section 10‑13: agencies have overlapping mandates, non‑transparent performance history."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "High caseload per NES case worker reduces quality of employer services and job matching.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Introduce case‑worker certification, re‑allocate staff, and create an active‑job‑seeker registry to lower caseloads.",
      "evidence": "Section 46‑47: caseload varies 200‑2,000; OECD benchmark <100."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Inadequate profiling of unemployed may cause misallocation of Active Labour Market Programs (ALMPs).",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and deploy a risk‑profiling tool, integrate it into NES MIS, and train staff on its use.",
      "evidence": "Section 48‑49: new methodology to profile unemployed; profiling tool required."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "High tax wedge and benefit withdrawal rates create work disincentives for low‑wage workers and social‑assistance beneficiaries.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design an in‑work cash transfer that offsets lost benefits and adjust social‑security contributions.",
      "evidence": "Section 51‑53: high tax wedge; DLI 9 aims to reduce work disincentives."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Fiscal consolidation may limit available budget resources for reform activities.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize budget‑neutral reforms, use results‑based financing, and secure donor co‑financing where needed.",
      "evidence": "Section 57‑58: fiscal consolidation noted; financing gap zero but limited fiscal space."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Perceived high level of corruption could undermine procurement integrity and stakeholder confidence.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce public disclosure of contracts, apply Bank anti‑corruption safeguards, and conduct regular audits.",
      "evidence": "Section 32‑33: perceived corruption high; mitigation measures listed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "External shocks such as floods or droughts could reverse economic gains and affect project outcomes.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include contingency buffers in timelines and budgets; monitor macro‑economic indicators regularly.",
      "evidence": "Section 1‑2: 2014 floods triggered recession; climate risks mentioned."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Weak monitoring and evaluation capacity may limit evidence‑based policy adjustments.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Build M&E skills within PPS and ministries, enforce semi‑annual progress reports, and conduct mid‑term review.",
      "evidence": "Section 24‑27: PPMC includes semi‑annual progress reports and annual performance reviews."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Technology Transfer Facility (TTF) may lack sufficient funding and expertise to generate transactions.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Allocate at least EUR 0.9 m annually, hire experienced TTF staff, and pilot service lines before scaling.",
      "evidence": "Section 40‑41: no public entity with TT capacity; EUR 0.9 m allocated for TTF."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Matching‑grant program may fail to meet the 80 % budget commitment target.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen international peer‑review and investment‑committee processes; set clear eligibility criteria.",
      "evidence": "Section 37‑38: 80 % of matching‑grant budget must be allocated via peer review."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delay in establishing the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) and hiring key staff could postpone project start.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set firm recruitment deadlines, monitor hiring progress, and use interim consultants if needed.",
      "evidence": "Section 60‑66: PIU to be established; staff recruitment timeline tied to effectiveness date."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "NES’s separate payroll system may have undetected data integrity issues due to lack of log reviews.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement periodic log audits, integrate automated reconciliation, and train staff on control procedures.",
      "evidence": "Section 79‑84: IT system generates logs but they are not regularly reviewed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Potential indirect environmental impacts from innovation activities could be overlooked.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Ensure all innovation sub‑projects undergo ESMF review and prepare Environmental Management Plans where needed.",
      "evidence": "Section 90‑91: Category B project; ESMF prepared; indirect impacts possible."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Insufficient stakeholder engagement may lead to low buy‑in from NGOs and business community.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain regular beneficiary surveys, public consultations, and transparent communication of results.",
      "evidence": "Section 19‑20: extensive consultations with NGOs, business reps; citizen engagement indicators."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Results‑based financing may cause cash‑flow problems for ministries if DLIs are not met on schedule.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain a contingency reserve, allow partial payments for interim DLI achievement, and stagger expenditures.",
      "evidence": "Section 84‑86: disbursements based on DLI verification; partial payments possible."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Changes in national budgeting processes could affect the timing of eligible expenditure reimbursements.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Align project milestones with the fiscal calendar, secure written commitments from ministries, and monitor budget approvals.",
      "evidence": "Section 17‑18: project relies on country’s budgeting system; variances between budget and actual noted."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Weak inter‑ministerial coordination may delay policy reforms and reduce effectiveness of the PPMC system.
risks.mitigation: Formalize the PPMC Working Group mandate, set clear roles, enforce semi‑annual reporting and senior‑level oversight.
risks.evidence: Section 24‑27: weak strategic planning and policy coordination; PPMC framework to be piloted.

risks.description: Public Policy Secretariat lacks sufficient fiduciary, procurement and reporting capacity to manage the loan.
